note: Pressure (GAME_SPEC §6, §13, Stage 28), played by a script: a flask boiled, stoppered and cooled falls below an atmosphere and boils below 100 C; heated again, its stopper pops; a bottle capped and heated bursts.

script.note: the flask boiled, its air driven out by steam
stoppered and cooled: a partial vacuum
warmed a little: it boils, sealed, below 100 C
heated hard: the stopper pops at its hold over the neck
the bottle capped and heated: its glass bursts
